svg.aria-label: Root locus of K over s(s + 4)(s squared + 4s + 20): the real-axis branches from 0 and minus 4 meet at minus 2 (K = 64) and turn vertical; they meet the branches from minus 2 plus or minus j4 at minus 2 plus or minus j2.45 (K = 100), then all four follow the 45 and 135 degree asymptotes from minus 2; the imaginary axis is crossed at plus or minus j3.16 when K = 260
svg.title: Root locus of K over s(s + 4)(s squared + 4s + 20): the real-axis branches from 0 and minus 4 meet at minus 2 (K = 64) and turn vertical; they meet the branches from minus 2 plus or minus j4 at minus 2 plus or minus j2.45 (K = 100), then all four follow the 45 and 135 degree asymptotes from minus 2; the imaginary axis is crossed at plus or minus j3.16 when K = 260

g.text: × poles 0, −4, −2 ± j4 · break points −2 and −2 ± j2.45 · asymptotes ±45°, ±135° from σa = −2
